texts.name: Marzum
texts.biography: Marzum made his name as a sadistic and influential governor by constantly exploiting his servants. It is said that there is nothing he loves more than a sound of the whip cracking on human skin.

specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Whippers or Overseers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
specialty.name: Whippers
